title: Device agent preferences
responsibility: Validates and persists the design count, using three when storage cannot provide a valid value.

inputs.name: AgentSettingsAdapter.constructor.config
inputs.description: The optional configuration for selecting the adapter storage object. If omitted, the constructor uses an empty configuration and read/write use globalThis.localStorage.

inputs.name: AgentSettingsAdapter.write.designOptions
inputs.description: The requested number of design options to persist. Only integer values from 1 through 10 are accepted; other numbers make write return false.

outputs.name: AgentSettingsAdapter.read
outputs.description: The design count selected for use, taken from stored designOptions only when it is a number from 1 through 10. Missing, invalid, inaccessible, or malformed stored data yields the default count of 3.

outputs.name: AgentSettingsAdapter.write
outputs.description: Whether the requested design count was saved. The result is false for an unsupported count, unavailable storage, or storage failure, and true after the value is stored.
